question: Does the causal fraction of a Passive limit order's pending lifetime consumed before fill separate the filled lifecycle's stressed return and stop-loss incidence broadly and materially enough to justify one later entry-preserving Passive post-fill response Proxy question inside the whole six-strategy portfolio?

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line. PASSIVE_PLACE precedes PASSIVE_FILL at equal time, and close precedes any later birth at equal time.
fixed_reconstruction.pending_identity: PASSIVE_PLACE opens the sole Passive pending lifecycle and supplies placement time, declared expiration and planned risk. The next PASSIVE_FILL admits it or PASSIVE_EXPIRE rejects it; overlapping or unmatched pending state is an integrity fault.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: PASSIVE_FILL begins the admitted position lifecycle. Its fill server time is the causal observation time for fill age.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the admitted lifecycle; value_b is native stressed net USD and detail reason=DEAL_REASON_SL marks a stop exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: close value_b divided by positive placement planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.fill_age_fraction: Seconds from PASSIVE_PLACE server_time to PASSIVE_FILL server_time divided by seconds from PASSIVE_PLACE server_time to its declared expiration. It is known at fill and must be in [0,1).
fixed_reconstruction.tail_construction: Separately inside every period sort admitted fills by fill_age_fraction ascending, then fill server time, fill state_sequence, source path and source line. EARLY is the first floor(n/3), LATE is the last floor(n/3), and the middle is excluded from tail effects.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_spearman: Average-rank Spearman correlation between fill_age_fraction and stressed_r over all 594 fills.
fixed_reconstruction.period_spearman: The same correlation separately in every period.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_tail_r_effect: Mean stressed_r for all LATE tail fills minus all EARLY tail fills.
fixed_reconstruction.period_tail_r_effect: The same LATE-minus-EARLY mean stressed-r difference separately in each period.
fixed_reconstruction.pooled_tail_stop_effect: Stop-loss rate for all LATE tail fills minus all EARLY tail fills.
fixed_reconstruction.period_tail_stop_effect: The same LATE-minus-EARLY stop-rate difference separately in each period.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 707 Passive placements, 594 fills and 113 expirations: fills P1/P2/P3/P4 equal 213/159/130/92 and expirations equal 38/19/29/27.
There is no overlapping, unmatched or period-end pending Passive order; every fill is strictly before its declared expiration and every pending lifetime is 3,587 through 3,600 seconds.
Every admitted fill has one positive planned risk and exactly one CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE, with no overlapping admitted Passive position.
Reconstruct exactly 594 admitted Passive lifecycles, 23.7622 USD stressed net and 26 stop-loss exits.

density: Every period contains at least 90 admitted fills and at least 30 observations in each EARLY and LATE tail.
All 594 fills have a valid causal fill_age_fraction and stressed_r.
economic_effect: Absolute pooled Spearman correlation between fill_age_fraction and stressed_r is at least 0.20.
At least three of four period Spearman correlations share the pooled sign.
Absolute pooled LATE-minus-EARLY mean stressed-r difference is at least 0.10R.
At least three of four period tail stressed-r differences share the pooled tail sign.
stop_coherence: Absolute pooled LATE-minus-EARLY stop-rate difference is at least 0.05.
At least three of four period stop-rate differences share the pooled stop sign.
The pooled stressed-r and stop-rate effects are economically coherent: lower LATE stressed_r requires higher LATE stop incidence, or higher LATE stressed_r requires lower LATE stop incidence.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later Passive post-fill response Proxy question. Unit 024 selects no management type, threshold, protection, hold duration, size, EA or Live candidate. Any later Proxy may not cancel, reject or reduce a base Passive fill, must retain the unchanged six-strategy entry opportunity set and must compare whole-portfolio net, drawdown, entry count and risk.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no fill-age response question. Do not rescue with fixed-minute thresholds, alternate quantiles, nonlinear transforms, fill-price displacement, direction, session, weekday, month, incumbent state or period exception.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading any fill-age-to-outcome result.
Run exactly one aggregation over the six frozen files.
Do not inspect another pending-age definition, threshold, fill displacement or subgroup inside Unit 024.
Do not run MT5, add MQL, create a reusable analysis CLI or touch Live.
Do not reopen or transform Unit 023.
